== Title ==
<span lang="ja">タトゥイーン：ドッキング・ベイ９４</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-129o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここから、他のドッキング・ベイに移動するには、１フォース必要。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここから、他のドッキング・ベイに移動するには、２フォース必要。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
No lore is printed on this card.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Tatooine: Docking Bay 94.

'''Light Side:''' Moving from here to another docking bay costs 1 Force.

'''Dark Side:''' Moving from here to another docking bay costs 2 Force.
